description: Curated collection of representative real onion images for SIH live evaluation.

images.purpose: Demonstration of individual onion localization, boundary segmentation, and morphometry extraction.
images.expected_behavior: Single isolated onion segmented with high confidence; contour and bounding box derived.

images.purpose: Multi-instance batch inspection demonstrating simultaneous segmentation and batch analytics.
images.expected_behavior: Multiple distinct onion bulbs localized and extracted into individual crops.

images.purpose: Physical scale calibration using a planar reference coin/disc to convert pixels into real millimetres.
images.expected_behavior: Reference disc detected; pixels_per_mm computed; bulb diameters reported in physical mm.

images.source_dataset: Dataset 2 (Red & White Onion Bulbs and Leaves)
images.purpose: Demonstrating high-confidence Healthy bulb classification using MobileNetV3-Small.
images.expected_behavior: Clean surface texture classified as Healthy; eligible for Grade A or B.

images.source_dataset: Dataset 2 (Red & White Onion Bulbs and Leaves)
images.purpose: Demonstrating surface defect / rotting detection and deterministic down-grading.
images.expected_behavior: Visible surface blemish classified as Unhealthy; grade capped at Grade C or Reject.

images.purpose: Evaluating instance separation performance when multiple bulbs are touching or occluded.
images.expected_behavior: YOLO polygon instance masks separate adjacent bulb boundaries.

images.purpose: External qualitative validation on unseen third-party produce sorting imagery.
